properties.name: St Clair River at the Chenail Ecarte (Ontario's half kept)
properties.source: Owner, Nov 7, a screenshot of the street map with the gap circled: Ontario's border water (ontario-border-water.geojson, from OpenStreetMap) took Ontario's half of the St Clair River off here, from about 42.638 to 42.660 N, while Michigan runs to the international line, so the two never met and the line between Michigan and Southern Ontario stopped mid-river. In this box the water isn't taken off Ontario, so it meets Michigan at the international line, as along the rest of the river.
